_note: Example preset box library for the design-email skill. Copy into a brand kit as presets.json and adapt. Colour values are palette-token NAMES resolved against the kit's brand.json palette. Geometry assumes a 724px column with 50px margin and 50px gaps.

standard-header._note: Logo/wordmark + nav row. Only instantiate if the brief or the brand's own reference creative calls for one.

primary-hero._note: Full-bleed brand-colour hero: headline, subhead, CTA.

sale-offer-band._note: Offer statement band with accent price/badge.

four-up-products._note: Product grid: image, name, price now/was.

standard-footer._note: Company block, boilerplate, utility links from the kit's footer object.
